description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.3.1
更新内容
- 一次截取多个区域：在同一截图中选择、编辑多个区域；开启紧凑布局并调整间距，减少导出、复制、贴图和识别结果中的空白。
- 更自由的标注外观：新增建筑师、艺术家、漫画家三种笔触风格；选区背景透明度可调，预设和历史记录会保留设置。
- 贴图操作更顺手：一键将全部贴图收起到顶部；可设置关闭贴图时先退出标注，支持重置缩放和直接销毁的鼠标动作。
- 图片与多屏操作：拼图和拆图支持粘贴图片，可拆分所选图片；截图时按 Ctrl+A 可扩展到全部屏幕，并可自定义 Windows 菜单访问键。
- 更轻巧、更稳定：缩小发布包，提升 ARM64 图片处理和录屏性能；修复压感笔宽度、拼图 PDF 保存、录屏静音图标、窗口捕获排除与剪贴板解码问题。
What's new
- Capture several regions at once: select and edit multiple regions in one screenshot. Use compact layouts with adjustable spacing to reduce gaps in saved, copied, pinned, and recognized images.
- Customize your annotations: choose Architect, Artist, or Cartoonist stroke styles and adjust selection background opacity. Presets and capture history retain these settings.
- Manage pinned images faster: hide all pinned windows at the top, choose whether closing first exits annotation mode, and assign mouse actions to reset zoom or close a pin immediately.
- Work with images and multiple displays: paste images into collage and split workflows, split a selected image, expand capture to all screens with Ctrl+A, and customize the Windows menu access key.
- Smaller and smoother: smaller downloads and faster ARM64 image processing and recording, with fixes for pen pressure, collage PDF saving, muted recording icons, capture exclusions, and clipboard decoding.
下载选择 / Choose your download
完整版提供全部功能；Mini 保留截图、标注、贴图、拼图、录屏和手动 OCR，精简高级识别、翻译和 API 配置。Windows Mini 首次识别时下载 OCR 组件和模型。/ Full provides all features. Mini keeps capture, annotation, pinning, stitching, recording, and manual OCR, with advanced recognition, translation, and API configuration removed. Windows Mini downloads OCR components and a model on first use.

macOS 快速安装 / Install on macOS
需要 macOS 15 或更新版本。以当前桌面用户在终端执行：/ Requires macOS 15 or later. Run in Terminal as your desktop user:
Snow Shot
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.3.1_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh --edition full
Snow Shot Mini（仅 Apple Silicon / Apple Silicon only）
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.3.1_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh --edition mini
脚本自动选择架构、校验安装包并完成本地签名。首次安装按提示授予屏幕录制和辅助功能权限。GitHub 下载不畅时，可把链接中的 https://github.com 替换为 https://gitee.com。/ The script selects your architecture, verifies the package, and signs it locally. Grant Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions when prompted. If GitHub is unavailable, replace https://github.com with https://gitee.com in download links or commands.
